acceptanceCriteria: Two lanes adding requirements to the same spec merge without conflicts outside the requirement list itself; docs/SPEC-DRIVEN-DEVELOPMENT.md names where intent-status history lives; `make spec-requirements` regenerates every derived row a lane previously hand-edited.
body:
Observed friction across the rc.3 lanes (V1-1276, V1-1277, V1-1278 S1..S3, V1-1281, V1-1336; memory of 2026-10-12: #831 went DIRTY against #829). Each lane appends to the same four shared-insertion points in a spec: the intent-status line in the header, the Agent digest, docs/specs/INDEX.json and README.md rows, and the generated REQUIREMENTS.tsv. Two lanes on one spec file conflict every time, and the resolution rule ('keep both sections, append the branch's tail, regenerate the TSV') is folklore held in agent memory, not in the SDD contract. Requirement ID ranges are reserved by chat (V1-1009 covers the ID collision itself; this ticket is the surrounding header state).

Expected: (a) the intent-status history moves to the build-log (one line per acceptance, already the decision-0423 shape) and the spec header keeps only the current status; (b) the Agent digest and INDEX/README rows are generated from the spec body by `make spec-requirements` like REQUIREMENTS.tsv, so a lane never hand-edits them; (c) REQUIREMENTS.tsv is not committed but checked (generated in CI from the staged specs), or is split per spec so two lanes touching different specs cannot conflict.
Actual: four hand-maintained insertion points per spec, conflicts on every concurrent lane, resolution rules outside the contract.

Version: origin/main 88197e465 (2026-10-13). Source: SDD review by the orchestrating session for decisions 0523/0525 after PRs #850..#855.
title: specs: intent-status tails, Agent digest lines and REQUIREMENTS.tsv regeneration conflict on every parallel lane; move per-lane state out of the shared spec header
